# Paññāparihīna Sutta (Iti 41 (It 2.14 PTS It 35))

**ID:** Iti 41 (It 2.14 PTS It 35)  
**Section:** Itivuttaka (iti)  
**Collection:** Sutta  
**Title (Pali):** Paññāparihīna Sutta  
**tipitaka.org (CST):** [https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0504m.mul1.xml](https://tipitaka.org/romn/cscd/s0504m.mul1.xml)

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Paññāparihīna Sutta* ("Bereft of Wisdom", Iti 41 / It 2.14, PTS It 35) is a discourse found in the second chapter (*Dukanipāta*) of the *Itivuttaka* that addresses the value and rewards of noble discernment. Secondary discussion of the sutta quotes its core verse praising wisdom as supreme in the world (*paññā hi seṭṭhā lokasmiṁ*) because it leads to penetration or breakthrough (*nibbedhagāminī*) and properly makes known the exhaustion of birth and continued existence (*jātibhavaparikkhayaṁ*), linking it to the overcoming of defilements and mistaken views [War Yar Mein Da 2015].
